description:
Integration and Inclusion Program for persons with disabilities - SEC - Report June to Aug 2026
Amount sponsored: Rs.8000/- per month towards remuneration of Vocational Trainer Mr. Subhas Jadhav
Focus on Product Finishing for Exhibition
• We received an opportunity from Araj Let's Care to showcase the products our students have learnt in the Vocational training classes.
• This opportunity was participation in two big exhibitions The LOOT on 29 July and The Polka Dots on 18 August
• The students made handmade Paper Bags, Envelopes, and Wrapping Papers for the exhibitions
• The exhibitions were a great success and a learning for the students to work under pressure and deadlines to complete making products.
• Several students showed great enthusiasm, visiting the centre on non-scheduled days to finish products for upcoming exhibitions.
Students used all their training and skills learnt during Vocational Training and achieved the aim of I&I Program of SEC where they earned an income.
